sloka: जटायो पश्य मम आर्य ह्रियमाणम् अनाथ वत् ।अनेन राक्षसेद्रेण करुणम् पाप कर्मणा ॥३-४९-३८॥
transliteration: jaṭāyo paśya mama ārya hriyamāṇam anātha vat ।anena rākṣasedreṇa karuṇam pāpa karmaṇā ॥3-49-38॥

translations.english: The heavyhipped Sita felt frightened in the grip of Ravana. When she saw Jatayu she screamed, shaken by sorrow:
